Observation Data: The City of Xylem
Video Record: BAWS Guard's Last Words
Video Record: The Collector's Last Words

Burst rifle developed by BAWS. Consumes kinetic
ammunition to deliver on reliable offensive potential,
both in terms of damage and impact. Can be charged
to fire burst shots.

High-speed linear rifle developed by Balam.
A special type of rifle that accelerates rounds using
electromagnetic propulsion. Charging the weapon further
increases round velocity, in turn increasing damage.

High-firepower linear rifle developed by Balam.
The lengthened barrel provides extra distance for rounds
to accelerate, allowing for high damage at long range.
However, this comes at the cost of rapid-fire potential.

Super heavy linear rifle developed by Balam.
The rounds fired by this rifle are electrically charged,
making them fire at extremely high speeds and pierce
through targets.

Machine gun created by Advanced Robotics Manufacturing Yard.
This machine gun requires no reloading and does not
overheat, allowing for sustained fire over long periods of
time. However, its overall firepower is lackluster.

Burst incendiary rifle developed by AWCAW. Rounds fired by
this weapon receive a secondary burst of speed mid-flight
thanks to internal combustibles, superheating the bullets
as well as speeding them up and increasing their range.

Burst assault rifle developed by BAWS. This weapon offers
high accuracy and spontaneous firepower thanks to its
burst-oriented design, leading to its mass production
for use by new recruits to the Rubicon Liberation Front.

Standard assault rifle developed by Balam. Balances
rapid-fire performance and firepower, making it easy to
use on full auto. A long-selling classic popular with
anyone from new corporate recruits to veteran mercenaries.

High-firepower assault rifle developed by Balam.
This variation has been adjusted to focus on the offensive
performance of individual shots. However, the longer
firing cycle demands more precise aiming.

Experimental Light Wave rifle developed long ago by the 
Rubicon Research Institute. This peculiar rifle boasts
relatively high damage for its weight alongside respectable
PA interference, at the cost of having negligible impact.

Powerful linear sniper rifle developed by Balam.
Fires a singular round a great distance through a similar
technology to normal Linear Rifles. The recoil is great
and requires a firing stance, but its range is unparalleled.

Double-barreled assault rifle developed by A.R.M.Y.
A powerful rifle that fires two rounds simultaneously.
Despite its lower rate of fire and low accuracy, this rifle
boasts incredibly high damage over time.

Hyperpulse rifle recently developed by Takigawa Harmonics. 
Rapidly amplifies tiny oscillations, then launches them 
at high speeds, leading to much more accurate and 
long-range projectiles.

Burst machine gun developed by BAWS.
The burst-oriented design of this weapon makes it both
easy to use and highly accurate. A strong candidate for
use as a sub-weapon in lightweight builds.

Machine gun developed by Balam. Has excellent rapid-fire
output, but somewhat lacking in firepower when used
alone. Shines in Double Trigger builds, whether using two
of this weapon or in combination with another.

Machine gun developed by Dafeng Core Industry.
This weapon was designed for sustained combat potential,
and uses oversize ammunition magazines. Minimal need
for reloading makes it well suited for suppressive fire.

Heavy machine gun developed by RaD.
An essential tool of the trade for RaD's "sales reps."
The briefcase-like compartment contains a replacement
barrel for particularly heated business discussions.

Laser Machine Gun mass-produced by Arquebus. Despite a
trademark of Laser weaponry ordinarily being its charging
capabilities, this weapon discards that potential in order
to create this highly potent weapon.

Heavy machine gun developed by RaD. Something of a cult classic, 
this weapon rewards controlled bursts, and offers a generous 
magazine capacity. However, it suffers from some of the worst recoil 
handling of any modern weapon.

Machine handgun developed by RaD shortly before its
downfall. Finished by an obscure Doser, this handgun
can empty its generous magazine in seconds, demolishing
targets in close proximity.

Gatling gun developed by Dafeng Core Industry. Equipped
with overwhelming rapid-fire performance and sustained
firepower, it embodies the "domination through material
superiority" mantra of Dafeng's parent company, Balam.

Gatling gun developed by Dafeng Core Industry.
Generates heat rapidly, but is able to expel it quickly. 
This weapon is suspiciously similar to an old BAWS
project, though Dafeng claims no relation.

Dispersal tri-gatling gun developed by A.R.M.Y..
Fires bullets in a wide spread, ideal for pushing
through crowds of lesser enemies or decimating larger
foes. Designed to be utilized with manual aim.

Burst Gatling Gun developed by BAWS. This gatling gun
builds off of the results produced by the Etsujin, one
of BAWS's most successful products. As they soon found,
"more bullets faster" was exactly what consumers wanted.

Compact bazooka developed by Melinite. Designed for
lightweight builds and indoor engagements. Compromises
have been made on the number and precision of rounds, but
it amply retains Melinite's trademark explosive power.

Medium-sized bazooka developed by Melinite. Known for
their attention to detail, even down to the composition of
the explosive charges, Melinite's engineers designed this
weapon for efficiency and ease of use from the ground up.

Bazooka developed by Dafeng Core Industry. Rounds
explode on contact, guaranteeing heavy impact damage
without ricocheting. With more rounds than most competing
models, Dafeng bazookas deliver on sustained firepower.

Unorthodox pile launcher developed by AWCAW.
Though the projectile is long-range, the initial
explosion that launches the pile out of the shaft can
deal significant extra damage to an enemy AC.

Heavy laser rifle developed by Arquebus. Fires a powerful
energy blast at a target, generating tremendous heat.
The precision of this shot makes it ideal for striking
targets who have overloaded attitude control systems.

Special shotgun developed by RaD. Strictly speaking,
this unique weapon is not a true shotgun, as its area
attacks are enabled by firing individual projectiles from
multiple barrels simultaneously.

Close-range shotgun developed by Balam. Fires in a spread,
resulting in excellent impact albeit with a short range.
Regardless, this weapon offers unparalleled potency in
close-range engagements.

Long-range shotgun developed by Balam. Uses specialized
large shells to improve shot density, extending effective
range but reducing the firing cycle.

Rapid-fire burst Shotgun created by BAWS.
Primarily effective at close range, this shotgun is very
effective at either building ACS strain on an enemy machine
or capitalizing on an existing ACS overload.

Linear shotgun developed by Balam. Developed after the
close of the Coral War to regain Balam some of its lost
funds, this shotgun is among the longest-range on the
market, and can be charged to tighten the spread.

Grenade launcher developed by Dafeng Core Industry.
Grenades create sphere-shaped explosions centered on the
point of impact, allowing each shot to deal significant
damage to multiple targets in a wide area.

Heavy grenade launcher developed by Melinite. A handheld
weapon painstakingly designed—from the composition of its
explosive charges to the specifications of its barrel—to
maximize firepower. Greatest blast radius in its class.

Grenade shotgun developed by Dafeng Core Industry.
Following their reaching the so-called "realistic limits"
of a grenade's blast radius, Dafeng turned to a new
approach to crowd control: adding more grenades.

Napalm grenade launcher created by AWCAW. Despite being
titled as a napalm weapon, the explosion created by this
grenade leaves a pool of lava in its wake, inflicting
significant damage upon enemy machines,

Needle gun developed by Elcano. A semi-auto weapon that
fires special needle-shaped ammunition. Provides a good
balance of attack power and impact.

Burst handgun developed by BAWS. This weapon is designed
to serve as a sub-weapon for contributing to ACS overload,
leveraging the accuracy and spontaneous firepower that
its burst-oriented design provides.

Large-caliber handgun developed by Balam. The rise of
Core Theory introduced a new kind of close-quarters combat
and with it a reappraisal of handguns, which demonstrate
stopping power with tremendous impact potential.

Long-barreled handgun developed by Balam. This model
increases firepower while retaining the impact potential
of its predecessor. Still, taking advantage of this weapon
in a large-scale engagement demands skill and experience.

Single-celled missile launcher developed by AWCAW.
Sometimes, a specific number of missiles are desired.
This weapon allows for more precision in accomplishing
your goals- contrary to AWCAW's usual style.

Incendiary handgun developed by Balam. Though it is
lacking in raw firepower and is often outclassed by the
prior models in many regards, this weapon fires incendiary
rounds that build ACS anomaly on targets.

Heavy tesla cannon developed by Arquebus ADD. Fires 
Concentrated electricity in a lightning-like form, which
jumps between enemies. However, this is just a prototype, 
and it has excessive heat building.

Small-caliber handgun developed by Dafeng. Like normal
handguns, this "fun-sized" model prioritizes stopping power,
and has excellent ammunition efficiency. However, one may
find its performance otherwise lackluster at best.

Jamming round launcher developed by BAWS.
Craft caught in the blast will suffer from compromised
lock-on capabilities. However, exploiting this trick calls
for considerable tactical finesse.

Napalm bomb launcher developed by BAWS.
Launches ultra-hot incendiary rounds that scorch the area
around the point of impact, limiting the maneuverability
of ground-based enemies.

Stun round launcher developed by RaD. Fires special
projectiles that scatter electrified metallic shards, the
effects of which build up to induce a forced electrical
discharge in the afflicted craft.

Handheld drone dispenser developed by VCPL.
Launches a singular drone that homes in on a target and
fires simple lasers at them. Charging launches three
laser turrets, which fire at a target in unison.

Pulse bomb launcher developed by Takigawa Harmonics.
Launches a singular, large bomb forward that releases
stored energy in an instant, creating a manner of blast
zone that can hit multiple enemies at once.

Bomb launcher developed by BAWS to fulfill a
contract with A.R.M.Y.. Fires an explosive that
detonates within close proximity to targets when
armed.

Black tar launcher developed by AWCAW. A support weapon 
that fires black tar projectiles at opponents. Targets 
covered in oil take additional damage from explosives and 
fire, though the oil is weak on its own.

Handheld multi-missile launcher developed by Furlong
Dynamics. A masterpiece of Furlong's second-gen
lineup, this weapon is capable of multi-locking up to
four targets.

Handheld split missile launcher developed by Furlong
Dynamics. An ambitious entry in Furlong's third-gen
lineup, this weapon improves accuracy with missile
payloads that split as they approach their target.

Handheld plasma missile launcher developed by Phalanx
Factories. Ideal for clearing large crowds, but can
only lock onto one target. Charge to fire missiles on 
a vertical arc.

Compact grenade launcher developed by Melinite. Defies
conventional wisdom that lightweight craft are forced to
rely on repeated weak attacks. Limited number of rounds,
but its blast radius and power are nothing to sneer at.

Laser handgun developed by Arquebus. Essentially a
miniaturized laser rifle, this energy weapon offers
unparalleled ease of use. Fires in bursts when charged.

Laser rifle developed by Arquebus. One of the most
commonly-used laser weapons on the battlefield, this
is a flagship product for the corporation. Can be
charged to amplify its power.

Prototype Coral beam weapon developed long ago by
the Rubicon Research Institute. Manipulates Coral swarm
intelligence using energy to adjust shape/directionality
of beam. Two-stage charge allows for fine-tuned control.

Single-barreled laser rifle designed by Arquebus ADD.
Fundamental performance has been improved in order to aid
the effort against the Planetary Closure Administration.
Can be charged to amplify its power.

Laser sniper rifle designed by Arquebus ADD.
This rifle lacks the recoil and firing stance 
of most sniper rifles, though by default it's
set to fire a shotgun-like volley for close ranges.

Former Coral weapon, repurposed into a laser rifle by
MARDOS due to the lack of available Coral remaining.
A husk of its former glory, there are far superior 
options in the market in all but sentimental value.

Experimental handgun developed long ago by the Rubicon
Research Institute. Following the Fires of Raven, most
Coral was burned to cinders, making finding ammunition for
what weapons remain a costly endeavor.

Plasma rifle developed by VCPL. Plasma explosions create
a damage-inflicting area that remains active for a brief
period of time. Charging the weapon causes the plasma
fire to scatter, producing multiple explosions.

Multi energy rifle developed by ALLMIND.
Capable of laser, plasma, or combined fire, this weapon
is equipped with a two-stage charge system that provides
a choice of firing modes.

Plasma shotgun developed by Phalanx. Fires several plasma 
projectiles over a wide horizontal spread. Charge to 
launch a horizontal wave of plasma that decimates crowds.

Ultra-heavy plasma rifle developed by Phalanx.
Though the exact way this weapon came about is unclear, it 
integrates a three-stage charging cycle, each with
increasingly devestating results.

Rapid-fire pulse gun developed by Takigawa Harmonics.
Destroys targets with sustained high-frequency
oscillation, making it especially suited for canceling
out pulse defenses, which use the same technology.

Spread pulse gun developed by Takigawa Harmonics.
This weapon features a larger oscillator to further
improve firepower and effective range, as well as
enhance its ability to cancel out pulse defenses.

Short-range pulse shotgun developed by Takigawa Harmonics.
Launches a spread of pulse oscillations, which cancel out
pulse shields in rapid bursts. The range of this shotgun
is short, but it can fire multiple times before overheating.

Double-barreled laser rifle designed by Arquebus ADD.
This is a power-hungry, high-performance variant that
features two barrels in a vertical juxtaposition.
Can be charged to amplify its power.

Laser shotgun developed by Schneider.
Dominates at close range with diffuse laser beams.
Charge the weapon to concentrate the beams and produce
a thrusting "spike" of energy.

Laser shotgun developed by Arquebus. True to style,
this weapon remains reliable at medium range. Charge
to concentrate the laser, producing an energy explosion.

Plasma rifle developed long ago by the Rubicon Research
Institute. Focuses on suppressive potential, prioritizing
rapid-fire performance over explosive power. Can be
charged to increase output and expand blast radius.

Experimental weapon developed long ago by the Rubicon
Research Institute. Manipulates Coral swarm intelligence
using energy to produce chain explosions. Charging the
weapon increases the number of these explosions.

Concentrated Plasma Rifle developed by VCPL.
This rifle's energy is much more potent at a specific sweet 
spot in its middle range, so take care to use it at that 
range. Charge to fire three homing plasma beams at a target.

Plasma rifle developed by Phalanx Factories. Uses special
stabilization cores to increase the duration that plasma
lingers for. Charge to increase power output.

Flamethrower developed by RaD. A weaponized form of
a tool used to melt down scrap at ultra-high temperatures.
Continued use at point-blank range is enough to outstrip
an AC's antithermal defenses.

Flamethrower developed by AWCAW. An extraordinarily
dangerous weapon that spits heavy flames. These flames
leave trails of fire in their wake, but are heavier, and
as such are slower and more affected by gravity.

Special bazooka developed by ALLMIND. Creates a chain
of explosions on contact that layer on impact damage.
Compared to standard explosive weapons, this weapon
has notably high direct hit damage.

Stun gun developed by Arquebus. Fires electrified probes,
the effects of which build up to induce a forced discharge
of electricity in the afflicted craft. Frequently used to
immobilize and seize hardware from enemies and rivals.

Handheld siege missile launcher developed by RaD.
The missiles linger for a short while after launch before
propelling themselves toward the target, allowing the
user to effectively surround their target single-handedly.

Handheld pulse missile launcher developed by Schneider.
The missiles create energy explosions on impact that
cancel out pulse barriers. Charge to switch to a burst
firing mode for improved rate of fire.

dangerous weapon that spits heavy flames. These flames

propelling themselves toward the target, allowing the
user to effectively surround their target single-handedly.

Handheld pulse missile launcher developed by Schneider.

cancel out pulse barriers. Charge to switch to a burst
firing mode for improved rate of fire.

Prototype Coral oscillator developed long ago by the

intelligence using energy to create a blade-like beam.

Light-wave blade developed long ago by the Rubicon

accompany slashing attacks with waves of light. Charge
to increase output, emitting larger waves of light.

Experimental weapon developed long ago by the Rubicon

using energy to accompany slashing attacks with waves of
light. Charge to increase output and produce larger waves.

Pulse blade developed by Takigawa Harmonics. Delivers
slashing attacks with high-frequency oscillation that are
ideal for canceling out pulse defenses. Charge to increase
output and pound targets with more powerful oscillation.

beyond conventional limits, taking large amounts of
energy but offering unrivaled cutting power.

Laser blade developed by VCPL. Stable laser control

combo attacks that sweep through the surrounding area.

Laser slicer developed by VCPL. This double-bladed weapon

targets. Charge to increase rotation speed and advance
aggressively while slashing through incoming fire.

Laser dagger developed by Arquebus. Designed for
close-range combat using lightweight craft, this energy
weapon is built to deliver agile slashing attacks. Charge

Kinetic blade developed by ARMY. This sword was designed

penalize enemy weaknesses. Initiates more strikes when 
used with controlled inputs.

Laser lance designed by Arquebus ADD. Uses the thrust of
its internal booster to launch into energy-based piercing
attacks. Booster thrust can be increased by charging the
weapon, allowing high-speed, long-distance rushes.

Chainsaw developed by RaD. Originally a tool used by
industrial demolition craft, now repurposed as a weapon.

a target to rapidly accumulate damage.

a rotating unit that uses centrifugal force and thrust
support to strike targets. Charge the weapon to scatter
mines as the weapon swings, causing plasma explosions.

target with a massive steel pile, obliterating it through
sheer physical force. Charge to prime the firing hammer,
enabling attacks that are enhanced by explosive damage.

deploy in anticipation of when enemy attacks will land.

after deployment to exhibit its true potential. Regular

damage. This revolutionary new technology came at 
the cost of almost all impact mitigation, however.

Cluster missile launcher developed by RaD.
